items.stem: Where do approvals and validation belong in an agent that writes to a system?

options.text: Before the write, as part of the action's custom business logic.
After the write, as a reconciliation report.
Nowhere; agents should not have approval logic.

items.stem: What must every competency agent do about out-of-scope questions?

options.text: Contain explicit error handling with a defined fallback behaviour.
Answer using the closest available source.
Escalate every question to a human.

items.stem: Which evidence does competency validation require for each agent?

options.text: A requirements document, an architecture review with a Glean technical resource, and a written business impact rationale.
A screenshot of the agent's final output.

items.stem: How should a partner prepare for the agent review call?

options.text: Expect to walk through and run each agent live, and ideally provide a recorded walkthrough beforehand.
Send documentation only and skip the live run.
Delegate the review to the customer's admin.
The set of content sources in play and what the agent can and cannot answer.
The maximum number of steps the agent may run.
Which model provider serves the request.
